title: New evidence of starvation crimes in Darfur
summary: In tonight's edition, a new report accuses Sudan's Rapid Support Forces of destroying farms around El Fasher before alleged mass killings in October 2025. contentText: In tonight's edition, a new report accuses Sudan's Rapid Support Forces of destroying farms around El Fasher before alleged mass killings in October 2025. Also, Congo-Brazzaville prepares to vote, but many young voters say they've lost faith in politics as veteran leader  Denis Sassou Nguesso seeks to extend his four-decade-long rule. And inflation in Libya is impacting local Ramadan celebrations.
